subject: Flagging platform renewal: proposed split pilot & evaluation criteria
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Flagging platform renewal: proposed split pilot & evaluation criteria

Team —

Our LaunchDarkly contract is up for renewal in Q2 and Optimizely has reached out with an aggressive trial offering. Rather than a straight renewal, I propose we run a short, controlled split pilot to compare:

- End-to-end tail latency under our traffic mix (page loads, server-side API calls)
- Cost per 100M flag evaluations with our current user segmentation
- Feature parity for gated rollout behaviors we rely on (percent rollouts, targeting, kill-switch)
- Developer experience: SDK stability, debug tools, audit events surfaced to our console
- Enterprise controls: SSO, audit logs, data residency options

Suggested pilot: two-week production shadow traffic + 7-day live traffic split (10% each vendor) on low-risk experiments (analytics flags only), with metrics collection in Grafana and a checklist of QA smoke tests. I attached a one-page pilot plan (flagging_pilot_plan_v1.docx).

Laura — can you engage both vendor renewals and request updated pricing/term sheets including:
- short-term trial pricing for the pilot
- any minimum commit thresholds
- SLA and support escalation matrices

Aditya — can you validate the pilot hypothesis and estimate the infra instrumentation work (approx hours)?

Marissa — please flag any procurement/legal constraints we should surface to vendors before they send proposals.

I want a quick decision path after the pilot: renew with the vendor that meets latency/cost thresholds and provides the required controls, or start migration planning.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kramer <sarah.kramer@launchdarkly.com>, Alan Choi <alan.choi@optimizely.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2027 10:03:21 -0800
Subject: RE: Flagging platform renewal: proposed split pilot & evaluation criteria

Hi Sarah / Alan —

Following up from Markus: wed like both of you to provide short pilot proposals and updated commercial terms. High level ask: 2-week shadow + 1-week live split (10% traffic) for low-risk flags. Please include:

- Pilot pricing or credits (line item)
- Any technical constraints or required SDK changes
- Support escalation contact for pilot (phone/email)
- Expected SLA coverage during pilot and for standard renewal
- Typical onboarding timeline for a production split

Attachments for your convenience: Markuss pilot plan.

Can you turn around a proposal by EOD Monday (2027-01-11)? Were trying to keep this tight to inform the Q2 procurement window.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call if helpful.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Kramer <sarah.kramer@launchdarkly.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:22:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Flagging platform renewal: proposed split pilot & evaluation criteria

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the plan. Quick responses: we can support the proposed pilot and provide a no-charge pilot credit for the 3-week window (covers flag evaluations and basic support). Ive attached an abbreviated pricing sheet (LD_pricing_Q1_2027.pdf).

Notes/asks from our side:
- For SDK instrumentation we recommend using our 6.0 JS SDK (minor patch) and server-side JVM SDK for server calls; should be backward compatible but Adityas team may need ~1-2 dev days to wire metrics.
- We can deliver streaming event exports to your Kafka topic for audit/event replay during the pilot; what retention do you need?
- Well need a mutually signed NDA addendum for any trial customer data sharing.

Well also provide a named pilot engineer (cc: Emily Reed) for integration troubleshooting. Let me know if you want a joint kickoff tomorrow.

Best,
Sarah Kramer
Renewals Lead, LaunchDarkly

Attachments: LD_pricing_Q1_2027.pdf (PDF; abbreviated pricing & support matrix)
From: Alan Choi <alan.choi@optimizely.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:46:01 -0800
Subject: Re: Flagging platform renewal: proposed split pilot & evaluation criteria

Hi Laura —

Thanks for outlining the scope. Optimizely can run a comparable trial; attached is a short spreadsheet with proposed pilot terms and an estimate for a temporary sandbox environment (Opti_trial_proposal.xlsx).

Quick technical notes:
- We can enable SDK-level debug logs at your request and provide an endpoint for differential evaluation logging to help compare flags across vendors.
- Our pricing model for trials is typically credit-based; we can cover the pilot entirely if were included in the renewal RFP for Q2 (standard commercial language applies).
- No minimum term on the trial; standard enterprise SLA would kick in on full contract.

If helpful, I can join the kickoff call and sketch the measurement hooks we recommend.

Regards,
Alan Choi
Enterprise Partnerships, Optimizely

Attachments: Opti_trial_proposal.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 07:18:34 -0800
Subject: RE: Flagging platform renewal: proposed split pilot & evaluation criteria

Markus/Laura —

Quick read on effort: to add transparent downstream instrumentation and a routed 10% traffic split for analytics flags I estimate:
- 1 engineer (backend) ~ 3 days to add split routing + metrics emission
- 1 frontend engineer ~ 2 days to toggle SDK config and smoke test
- 0.5 SRE day to add dashboards and alerting for error spikes/latency regressions

Ill prototype the split and a small Harness job for traffic steering; well use a config flag to opt-in per flag namespace. Also: please confirm data retention requirement for events so we can wire Kafka retention accordingly.

Aditya
Senior Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nexismedia.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Flagging platform renewal: proposed split pilot & evaluation criteria

All —

I checked with procurement and legal: two items to surface before pilots start:
1) NDA addendum for trial data access (LD requested this) — procurement can push a one-page addendum; legal prefers were explicit about event forwarding and retention windows.
2) Temporary SLAs / liability cap language for pilots — vendors need to confirm theres no unintended exposure for data processing during the trial.

Procurement has asked vendors to send a consolidated pilot quote and a redlined terms PDF by EOD Thursday (2027-01-14). If both vendors comply, we will greenlight the engineering work and schedule a kickoff (goal: pilot start 2027-01-25).

Marissa Cole
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
